data.narrative:
Strata Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Zhou and Alex Mason that has raised $5.2M to date. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $5.2M total raised proxy, reflecting typical Seed-to-next-stage capital progression in the sector. This yields an implied valuation of $13M. A Peer-Median approach could not be applied, as the broader peer set lacks sufficient datapoints within filtered cohorts (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier); while 8 same-sector peers exist, none of the narrow filters produced the three or more comparable transactions required for a credible median.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $15M (high), with a median of $13M. This range reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation multiples in an early-stage, capital-intensive sector. Key uncertainties include unit economics validation, capital efficiency relative to comparable-stage peers, and the company's pathway to Series A fundraising. A more robust peer-median approach would require either additional transaction data within narrow cohorts or acceptance of broader sectoral comparables.
